scope: Proposed planner overlay, not a site approval. Merge rules only; never overwrite generated room.json.
selectors: Python/ECMAScript-compatible regex, full string match against layout item id. Missing expected matches => review.
frame: Use physical operator front; local -Y at zero for verified bench models, then apply rot. Supply per-model face mapping if not verified; never infer cable-chain side from room direction.
null_meaning: No defensible fixed offset, not zero, permission to touch, or automatic pass. Apply check-specific geometry or obtain measurements.
decision: Apply every matching rule in scope. Max of applicable minima for the SAME measured quantity only. Mandatory failure = conflict with named authority, not necessarily unlawful. Reference solutions may differ only on documented approved equivalent. Unverified inputs = review; recommendations = advisory.
collision: Use height-sliced solid parts and occupied states. Exclude intended support contact, not cabinet panels or other machines. Draw stock paths, open doors and seated users. Never use an overhead accessory or occupied bench as an unbroken floor obstacle.
inputs: route centreline/polygons with role, design-user count, traffic and approved fire plan
finished clear opening, threshold, latch and actual hinge; door schedule
station points, working states, approach side, operating orientation, peer simultaneous-use policy
service and stock envelopes, shelf inside faces and commissioned ventilation evidence

room_checks.title: Mark the actual walking lines
room_checks.applies_when: designated local workshop circulation, excluding machine service-only gaps
room_checks.reason: Protect a continuous route in the occupied layout. Use the laser default only for its dedicated aisle; a classified corridor or escape route can demand more. Do not reject all furniture-to-wall gaps.

room_checks.title: Reserve door approaches and the leaf sweep
room_checks.applies_when: door swings for all doors; v1 approach strips at the designated entrance and escape doors
room_checks.reason: Keep equipment, waiting positions, chairs and stored material outside the polygons. Both laser doors must remain usable. The 900 mm scalar is strip depth perpendicular to a doorway, not clear opening width or a complete access landing.

room_checks.title: Low-traffic accessible corridor
room_checks.applies_when: universal-design corridor or access balcony classified as low traffic
room_checks.reason: §§6.1.3 and 6.4.4 main rule 4(a): schools fall within universal design. Measure the unobstructed corridor between finished faces and projections. The general duty is enough width for the actual traffic.

room_checks.title: Busy or long accessible route
room_checks.applies_when: high traffic OR long internal route without dedicated wheelchair passing bays
room_checks.reason: §6.4.4 reference rule 1: apply the reference solution unless an equivalent design is documented. The designer classifies traffic and length; furniture spacing alone cannot classify either.

room_checks.title: Passing places on narrower corridors
room_checks.reason: §6.4.4 reference rule 2: provide clear passing places at intervals appropriate to expected traffic. Do not invent an interval. High traffic uses the larger square; a bay alone does not waive a busy-route rule.

room_checks.title: Space to manoeuvre at a corridor door
room_checks.applies_when: outside a door on a universal-design corridor/access balcony; separately outside the building main entrance
room_checks.reason: §6.4.4 main rule 4(b): fit either full rectangle; high traffic needs the larger square. §6.4.2 requires level space outside the main entrance outside the door sweep and ≥500 mm latch-side room outside entrance doors. Do not automatically classify the internal lab-to-hall door as a building entrance.

room_checks.title: Turn at a teaching station
room_checks.applies_when: at accessible teaching positions and changes of direction selected with the access designer
room_checks.reason: Reserve a usable 1500 mm diameter clear circle reached from the accessible route. A disc is a planning test at a workstation, not a substitute for the statutory rectangle at a corridor door or a guarantee for every chair. Check knees, reach and controls in section.

room_checks.title: Measure the opening with the leaf open
room_checks.applies_when: building entrance or universal-design interior door; larger fire/traffic requirements prevail
room_checks.reason: §6.4.2: entrance ≥830 × 2070 mm clear; §6.4.3: interior ≥800 × 2000 mm clear, subject to the article’s limited cupboard-like exceptions. Inspect usable opening, stops, leaf and hardware; nominal rough opening and leaf widths are not evidence. Both articles give 25 N at handle and 40 N max push/pull guidance.

room_checks.title: Protect the entire escape route
room_checks.applies_when: all occupied spaces and assigned escape routes
room_checks.reason: §§9.5.2–.4, .6–.9 and 581/1995 §37: trace routes to approved safe destinations, including common routes; check clear width, travel and exit independence against the fire design. Normally two independent routes per use unit; exceptions require verification. Two leaves of one door do not give two independent routes. Signage and emergency lighting require field review.

room_checks.title: Check exit capacity and route loss
room_checks.applies_when: fire design supplies use classification, occupancy, shared flows and exit grouping
room_checks.reason: §9.5.8 reference 1–4: aggregate at least 1 m per 100 people; with one route lost, remaining capacity 200 people per metre. Merged flows add. Door/route from a space for >300 people: ≥1.2 m. These are distinct tests, not blanket aisle widths. Use §9.5.6 table 9.04 and its measurement rules for travel distance.

room_checks.title: Direction and release of escape doors
room_checks.applies_when: designated escape door or dedicated workplace emergency exit
room_checks.reason: §9.5.9: open in direction of escape, without key or tools; open leaf must not constrict escape. Reverse swing exception requires familiar users AND no crowd risk, not merely a small headcount. 581/1995 §37 specifically requires outward-opening dedicated emergency doors. Check fire-door rating, approved hold-open/release, hardware and power-loss behaviour against the schedule.

room_checks.title: Separate occupied stations from through-traffic
room_checks.applies_when: normal simultaneous work or stock transport
room_checks.reason: 581/1995 §§3,39: size and mark routes for users and material movements; workers need sufficient room outside traffic areas unless the work requires otherwise. Model occupied chairs, helper, sheet destination and swept path. UK BB81 §5 allows some shared work space only under stated usage assumptions. Never borrow a protected route for storage.

room_checks.title: Capture fumes where they form
room_checks.applies_when: laser, solder, CNC dust and other contaminating tasks
room_checks.reason: 581/1995 §10: capture/clean contaminated air at source and prevent return of polluted air to the workplace; maintain and verify function. Check make-up air, discharge, filter access, branch compatibility and capture with the proposed simultaneous duty. A riser, duct or fan icon does not prove performance.

room_checks.title: Provide supervision and accessible fire equipment
room_checks.applies_when: laser in use or ready to print; all teaching configurations
room_checks.reason: Keep a clear attended operator position with direct view, reachable controls and suitable inspected extinguisher. Keep combustibles and offcuts clear; reserve panel, tray and cleaning access. Workplace §3(7) requires suitable firefighting and detection equipment for the actual risk. Agree equipment with the fire designer.

room_checks.title: Confirm laser class and control the usable area
room_checks.applies_when: Pro HD or F1 Ultra; include passthrough/conveyor or open configurations
room_checks.reason: Glowforge Pro HD is Class 4: use the manufacturer’s laser safety programme. For F1 Ultra read the nameplate: MXF-K002-001 is Class 1, B20/B21 are Class 4. Do not infer classification from a green hood or ordinary glazing. Have the laser safety lead assess access and sightlines before class use.

machine_clearances.title: ShopBot PRSalpha 120-60
machine_clearances.reason: The architects’ equipment schedule asks for at least 1 m on all sides for handling and service. Use full body, not cutting bed, and exclude overhead boom from floor footprint. Also draw the actual load-in and stock sweep. A change needs a revised brief.

machine_clearances.title: ShopBot cable-chain side
machine_clearances.applies_when: cable-chain side positively identified; check control-box and origin ends separately
machine_clearances.reason: ShopBot suggests about 300–500 mm at the far chain side to allow access but discourage traffic there. Leave more on the control/origin side and room to load from a short end. Its illustration is a 96-48, not the Saga 120-60 footprint. This advice does not cancel the 1 m brief.

machine_clearances.title: Epilog Fusion Edge 24
machine_clearances.reason: Do not obstruct cooling fans on either side. Fit and service the rear 102 mm port and hose, fully open lid and service panels. In the reviewed manual no fixed wall setback was specified. External exhaust guidance is 595–680 m³/h, not a filter-unit rating or the flow for the entire room. Confirm hardware by nameplate.

machine_clearances.title: Glowforge Pro HD casing
machine_clearances.reason: Manual: leave at least one inch all around; keep underside air intake clear. Offsets are from the casing, not the hose tip. Add space for lid, connections and sheets; the air gap alone is insufficient to operate.

machine_clearances.title: Pro HD passthrough
machine_clearances.reason: Slots run front to rear. Compute maximum protrusion from stock length, position and support path; reserve both ends. Otherwise label this placement closed-job only. Fit Pro Shields when not using passthrough as directed.

machine_clearances.title: Glowforge Aura
machine_clearances.applies_when: all jobs; lateral feed envelope when passthrough is enabled
machine_clearances.reason: Both slots open at the SIDES. Reserve the full height and length of protruding stock plus support; keep the underside intake and lid clear. No fixed perimeter distance verified in the Aura manual. Do not copy the Pro HD inch rule.

machine_clearances.title: Glowforge outdoor exhaust
machine_clearances.applies_when: outdoor vent option; otherwise use the exact compatible filter
machine_clearances.reason: Both manuals limit the outdoor hose/vent path to 2.4384 m without added turns in the vent. HD gives no more than two turns of ≤90° for the hose. Keep hose unpinched. Aura uses Personal Filter, not Performance Filter. Treat shared-building ducting as unapproved until manufacturer and ventilation designer validate it.

machine_clearances.title: xTool F1 Ultra
machine_clearances.applies_when: tower plus controller in the planned normal configuration
machine_clearances.reason: Schedule provides 700 × 500 mm of bench space and an 80 mm exhaust connection. Verify against the actual unit. Allow the shield to lift and controls and emergency stop to be reached; keep exhaust clear. If a conveyor is fitted, draw its full feed and outfeed separately. No fixed OEM side clearances verified.

machine_clearances.title: MK3S+ in Saga’s custom cabins
machine_clearances.applies_when: custom birch single-door cell, from moving printer envelope
machine_clearances.reason: The schedule calls for 100–150 mm above and behind for cooling/service. Screen at the lower edge (100 mm); aim for 150 mm. Check bed, rear cable and spool at full travel. Measure door sweep from its own hinge, and test cabinet temperatures and emissions at class duty.

machine_clearances.title: Original Prusa Enclosure only
machine_clearances.applies_when: only if installed enclosure model equals Original Prusa Enclosure
machine_clearances.reason: The factory enclosure needs 250 mm clear in front of ITS doors. External size is 530 mm wide × 545 mm high and 640/715 mm deep with the LCD inside/outside. The 250 mm is not Saga’s custom door sweep.

machine_clearances.title: Bambu Lab P2S
machine_clearances.reason: Bambu specifies at least 4 mm each side and 100 mm at rear for intakes, tube and purge chute. Keep front door swing, rear discharge, cables and service reachable; those are additional measured spaces.

machine_clearances.title: P2S with top-mounted AMS 2 Pro
machine_clearances.reason: The architects’ schedule asks for ≥800 mm total clear height from supporting surface for a top AMS. Also verify open lid and maintenance reach on the real assembly. Do not apply to a bare P2S.

machine_clearances.title: Roland monoFab SRM-20
machine_clearances.reason: Roland §2.2 depicts a 500 × 500 mm installation square within a 1000 × 1000 mm working square; support ≥600 mm above floor. Preserve both rectangles; the figure does not dimension per-edge offsets from the casing. Confirm full cover opening and cleaning/tool change. Saga separately requests 600 × 600 mm support plus computer.

machine_clearances.title: Roland CAMM-1 GS-24
machine_clearances.applies_when: cutting location; parked location is not operating clearance
machine_clearances.reason: E-13: 1000 × 1000 mm main unit space within 2000 × 2000 mm work space; install ≥600 mm above floor. No obstacles at front or rear: stock travels. Draw the longest planned media path even if it exceeds the working square. Mark a distinct operating position for a wheeled stand.

machine_clearances.title: Soldering stations on microelectronics bench
machine_clearances.applies_when: three solder stations grouped in the host; evaluate each active iron
machine_clearances.reason: Locate extraction at each source, maintain it, and verify capture at the working point without the plume crossing the face. HSE warns bench boxes have limited use without HEPA; a modelled fan or HEPA label does not prove capture of all contaminants. Reserve hood movement, operator and filter change; no universal mm setback verified.

machine_clearances.title: Sewing, embroidery and overlock
machine_clearances.applies_when: each occupied sewing position with actual machine and attachments
machine_clearances.reason: Reserve chair travel, pedal, fabric and moving embroidery hoop; keep leads off walking routes and separate hot presses. HSE requires attention to lighting, guards and posture. Saga machines are stand-ins, so obtain real manuals and measure moving envelopes before setting offsets.

overrides.quote: We accept a reduced clearance for the shopbot.
overrides.note: CNC room keeps its size (3.34 m across); the brief's 1 m all round the ShopBot is reported, not a violation.

overrides.quote: The SRM-20s look fine to me in the model. Same for the vinyl cutters. But we'll re-arrange all those machines soon anyways.
overrides.note: Roland's 1000 x 1000 mm installation space; the two SRM-20s' spaces overlap 0.4 m. Accepted as modelled until the electronics area is re-arranged.

overrides.quote: The SRM-20s look fine to me in the model. Same for the vinyl cutters. But we'll re-arrange all those machines soon anyways.
overrides.note: Roland's 2000 x 2000 mm installation space; the two GS-24s' spaces overlap 0.98 m. Accepted as modelled until the cutter corner is re-arranged.
